lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters are arranged in a semi-grid pattern posterior to the gills, with a primary grouping of five nodes forming a non-equilateral pentagonal configuration above the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, with the highest-luminance centroids positioned at the nodes of this orthogonal grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, marked by a linear intensity gradient showing high-reflectance upper edges followed by distinct ventral shadowing.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of complex, vermiculated high-luminance patterns interconnecting some of the larger circular spots on the mid-lateral flank.
